notes: Entity metadata and executable representation profiles: compile selected entries through event_universe.entities into an ordinary Initialization input; the catalog itself is not a world.

Each profile supplies bounded scalar/vector data for the generic entity compiler; selected profiles must fit runtime field, rule, type and slot limits. Profiles do not establish physical dynamics or emergence.
Electric charges are integer multiples of one third of the elementary positive charge. Twice-spin values are identity metadata, not implemented spin dynamics.
No numerical masses are assigned here. Neutrino flavor records are not mass eigenstates; their paired IDs distinguish interaction labels without deciding Dirac or Majorana self-conjugacy.
The gluon entry denotes the eight-generator adjoint multiplet, not eight uncoupled scalar fields or eight additional antiparticle species.
Conserved component sums do not establish physical field energy or momentum; flux, constraint, dispersion and continuum-limit acceptance remain independent.
Known microscopic species are not all classical particles. A classical proxy omits their quantum and internal structure.
Creation and annihilation require local product ownership and total energy-momentum-charge accounting; opposite charge never means negative mass.
Source references document physical classifications. Runtime support assessments follow the project contracts and do not claim implementation by citation.
Every quantum_profile is an explicit finite mode preparation. Use --representation quantum; unsupported dynamics remain listed, including for hypothetical entries.

assumptions: Two vector payloads only; copying them does not implement Maxwell dynamics or physical electromagnetic energy.
